notes.title: Farewell
notes.notes:
Hello,

After the key revocation, I made some choices.
In past two years, I couldn’t work on this game because (Thanks to our education system) I was studying for university enterance exam. So only thing I could do about this game was just some little updates that I’ve done in 1-2 weeks maximum.
When I really got free time –this last two weeks- I started working on this game again but I lost most of the project files thanks to a cryptolocker virus so I started working on a redaction of this game but I don't think I should work on this project anymore.
Because as I can see, nobody cares about this game. They care about the space that the game will occupy in their libraries.

So after a few hours of thinking I decided to put this game out of its misery. I’ll contact Valve for removal of this game from store. The unpublishing will happen probably within a week or two.

You probably hate me because of the key revocation thing, and I understand your fury. I’m so sorry if I made you bored or stole your time. I hope you all forgive me.

So, until I decide otherwise;

Farewell,
FranticDreamer.
